name: Salesforce Lightning Design System 2
summary: A CRM-scale system that uses global styling hooks, adjustable density, intentional contrast, and a more modern expressive layer while preserving the predictable semantics required by complex enterprise workflows.
signature_traits: expressive motifs bounded by operational semantics
best_for: products with many repeated data and action patterns
avoid_for: small editorial sites where enterprise configurability adds needless complexity
products that copy Salesforce motifs without the underlying workflow semantics
